rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for regular money paid after retirement.

example.english: I receive a pension every month after retirement.
example.traditional: 我退休後每個月都有退休金收。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teoi3 jau1 hau6 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jau5 teoi3 jau1 gam1 sau1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a government or civil-service retirement pension.

example.english: Government civil servants can receive a pension every month after retirement.
example.traditional: 政府公務員退休後每月可領長俸。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gung1 mou6 jyun4 teoi3 jau1 hau6 mui5 jyut6 ho2 ling5 coeng4 fung2
